Recurring job count: backend creates count-1 child docs (range(1, count) = [1, 2] for count=3), so total = 1 original + 2 copies = 3 total. This matches spec.
live_location_routes.py GET response (line 191-198): dest_lat and dest_lng are included in the response. VERIFIED.
